title: Godot 4.3 Could not load ICU data. UErrorCode: 2 Crash

### Tested versions

Reproducible in both 4.3 and 4.4 stable (GDScript and C# versions)

### System information

OpenSUSE Tumbleweed - Vulkan - AMD RX 7800XT

### Issue description

The current command I am using to launch just for testing was `./godot --display-driver wayland -v --rendering-method forward_plus`

I have confirmed the exact same behaviour occurring with or without any flags, and the same occurs in the GDScript/Non C# version as well. Installing the flatpak of the GDScript 4.4 version seems to work fine, so not entirely sure if this is a Godot problem or if there's an issue with a dependency on my system

Thanks!

### Steps to reproduce

Simply launching Godot results in the error

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, Godot won't launch at all
